recognize_zh: D 圖中壞死、疏鬆區域內有數個鮮紅色、細長菱形/針狀的結晶，即 Charcot-Leyden 結晶；搭配 C 圖滿是嗜伊紅性顆粒細胞質的高細胞性骨髓，提示伴嗜伊紅球增多的骨髓腫瘤。
features: Aspirate (A): left-shifted granulocytic cells including promyelocytes/myelocytes and eosinophilic precursors; blasts not conspicuous
Trephine low power (B): markedly hypercellular marrow filling intertrabecular spaces
Trephine high power (C): sheets of myeloid cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, consistent with increased eosinophils and precursors
Trephine (D): loosely cohesive, degenerating/necrotic area containing bright eosinophilic, elongated bipyramidal (diamond/needle-shaped) Charcot-Leyden crystals
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulocytic hyperplasia with eosinophilic precursors and no conspicuous increase in blasts. The trephine biopsy is markedly hypercellular (near 100%), with sheets of myeloid cells showing abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm consistent with increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors. A focus of necrosis contains several brightly eosinophilic, elongated bipyramidal crystals consistent with Charcot-Leyden crystals. In the setting of PDGFRB rearrangement by FISH, findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRB rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CML shows similar granulocytic hyperplasia with eosinophils and basophils and can contain Charcot-Leyden crystals, but it is excluded by absence of BCR::ABL1.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks marked marrow hypercellularity with a left shift and splenomegaly, and has no clonal rearrangement such as PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2.
Mastocytosis shows compact spindled CD117+/tryptase+ mast cell aggregates and KIT D816V, rather than a pure eosinophilic myeloid proliferation.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are sharply defined, bright pink, bipyramidal and needle-like, whereas bone fragments are lamellar and artifacts are irregular and non-geometric.
